subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】cold 冷的; warm 温暖的; hot 热的; cool 凉爽的; sunny 晴朗的; windy 有风的; cloudy 多云的; snowy 下雪的; rainy 下雨的; outside 外面
【重点句型】What's the weather like? 天气怎么样？ It's ... 是……天气。 Can I go outside? 我能出去吗？ Yes, you can. / No, you can't. 可以。/ 不行。 Be careful! 小心！
【A Let's talk】Mark: Hi, Chen Jie! This is Mark. Chen Jie: Hello, Mark! What's the weather like in New York? Mark: It's rainy. How about Beijing? Chen Jie: It's sunny and warm.
【Read and write】Good morning. This is the weather report. It's warm in Beijing. It's cold in Harbin. It's hot in Hong Kong. It's cool in Lhasa. It's snowy in Shenyang. Have a nice day!
key_points: What's the weather like? 天气怎么样？
Can I go outside? 我能出去吗？
Yes, you can. / No, you can't. 可以。/ 不行。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
